description_en: Queries the error logs of a lightweight database instance
kebab_example: aliyun swas-open describe-database-error-logs --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --database-instance-id db-38263fa955774501a2ae1bdaed6f0000 --start-time 2022-09-07T04:04Z --end-time 2022-09-08T04:04Z --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDatabaseErrorLogs

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the lightweight database instance resides.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html operation to query the latest list of Alibaba Cloud regions
parameters.help_zh:
指定的轻量数据库实例所属的地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html查看支持的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the lightweight database instance
parameters.name: database_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The number of error logs to return per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The start of the time range to query. The time must be in UTC and formatted as `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ` according to the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html standard.

The time displayed in the console is 8 hours ahead of the specified UTC time
parameters.help_zh:
查询错误日志起始时间。按照https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html标准表示，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ。

+8小时后是控制台上显示的到期时间
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. The time must be in UTC and formatted as `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ` according to the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html standard. This value must be later than the start time.

The time displayed in the console is 8 hours ahead of the specified UTC time
parameters.help_zh:
查询错误日志截止时间。按照https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html标准表示，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ。截止时间需大于起始时间。

+8小时后是控制台上显示的到期时间
parameters.name: end_time

CreateTime.description_en:
The time when the error log was generated. The time is in UTC and formatted as `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` according to the [ISO 8601]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html） standard.

The time displayed in the console is 8 hours ahead of the specified UTC time
CreateTime.description_zh:
错误日志生成时间。按照[ISO 8601]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html）标准表示，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

+8小时后是控制台上显示的到期时间

ErrorInfo.example: spid52 DBCC TRACEON 3499, server process ID (SPID) 52. This is an informational message only; no user action is required

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of matching error logs
